revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready. Kept σοφ in lin15 and relegated the other suggestions for lins13, 14, 15 to the apparatus.
General - Fixed the encoding of lin7. Not sure now about lines 13, 14, 15. Possible to preserve the suggestions like this, for example, <:ἐν γ̣ῇ|ed|ἐπ̣ὶ̣ γ̣ῆς̣=PN C. Balamoshev (from image):>.

Vote - AcceptText - Agreed with Nick. BL 11.224 should be incorporated into the l. 7 correction, so the full history can be seen: <:Ἑρμαῶτος=PN C. Balamoshev (from image)|ed|<:<:Ἑρ̣μαυῶτος̣|alt|Ἑρ̣μαῶτος̣:>=BL 11.224|ed|Ἑρμανῶτος̣:>:> (or however this complicated correction is properly entered)

Vote - AcceptText - The correction to lin7, in part anticipated, in BL XI 224 is good. The suggestions for lines 13 and 14 are dubious, and I would not put them in the text. The new readings in lin15 look acceptable, but as no consecutive sense emerges, I'd only keep the begging, σοφ in place of σο\ῦ̣/ .1[. Next voter? (Remove the indications of superscript υ, i.e. \υ/; this writing of υ is standard practice.)
Submit - Revised readings in various lines. From image. Changes involve lines 7,13,14,15,16.
Commit - Main changes in lines 7, 13,14, 15. From image.
